Why is a circuit breaker or a fuse used in a mains electric circuit?
A
It allows spare current to be returned to the mains.
B
It improves the insulation of the wiring.
C
It protects the mains wiring from current overload.
D
It saves energy by reducing the current.

options.label: A
options.text: It allows spare current to be returned to the mains.

options.label: B
options.text: It improves the insulation of the wiring.

options.label: C
options.text: It protects the mains wiring from current overload.

options.label: D
options.text: It saves energy by reducing the current.
